name: 210. Upstream server instructions reach the code mode stub files (code-mode-instructions) [SERIAL]
description:
Code mode replaces an upstream's tools with four meta-tools (listToolFiles, readToolFile, getToolDocs, executeToolCode) and moves the real tool documentation into a virtual .pyi filesystem. The gateway handshake already forwarded each upstream's `instructions` (folder 172), but the stub files carried none of it: the model was told the server's rules in the system prompt, naming tools it was never sent, and then read a stub that said nothing about them immediately before generating the call. These cases pin that the instructions now ride with the server on every surface that documents it, bounded by the same per-client cap.

Serial, and it provisions its own client: the shared python profile has no code-mode client, and a code-mode client makes the four meta-tools visible to every MCP-bearing request while it exists, so the create and the delete bracket the reads rather than living in the profile. The upstream is the same SSE fixture as sse_mcp (examples/mcps/remote-test-server), which advertises instructions on its initialize handshake.
